title: Who will receive the longest prison sentence at the trial over the July 2023 burglary of Gianluigi Donnarumma's Paris home?
background: Goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma and his partner were attacked during a burglary at their Paris home in July 2023.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The Paris Criminal Court's judgment, as documented by the court or reliable contemporaneous reporting. 
  Resolution Conditions : Identify the defendant receiving the longest total prison sentence in the trial verdict delivered by September 30, 2026. Compare sentences actually imposed, including any suspended portions, rather than sentences requested by prosecutors. Later appeals do not affect resolution. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The defendant's name as publicly reported.
